_comment: Pinned upstream benchmark artifacts. The blog quotes numbers that are
measured in OpenAdaptAI/openadapt-flow. This file pins the exact commit and
the exact bytes those numbers came from, so scripts/check_benchmark_claims.py
can compare a published figure to its artifact instead of trusting a copy.
To move the pin: change 'commit', re-vendor every file under upstream/ from
that commit, update each 'sha256', then rerun the checker and fix whatever
goes red. Never edit a vendored file by hand.
commit_note: The commit where the corrected OpenEMR oracle adjudication landed. The saved-row verifier rejects compiled run 20, so OpenEMR compiled success_count is 19 of 20, not 20 of 20.
